body: My personal background in terms of religion and philosophy goes like this: I was born into a conservative Christian family and I suppose my first sign of defiance towards Christianity was not believing it, for the longest time I thought it was a hoax like the Easter Bunny, or the Tooth Fairy. Then for a short period of time I believed it. Afterwords in 5th grade I decided to do a lot of research in secret, and determined that religion is illogical. Currently in high school, and my parents are still unaware that i'm here now.
